attention: v^T tanh(W_query*h_last + W_key*h_j + bias); mask pads before softmax
embedding_cache: no learned embedding reuse across weight updates
gat_neighbors: incoming edges plus self exactly once
gradient_path: joint MLP,GAT,LSTM,attention,head; dictionary and raw similarities fixed

initialization.attention: linear rule above; final vector Xavier uniform gain1
initialization.recurrent: every weight uniform(-1/sqrt(hidden_width),+1/sqrt(hidden_width)); all biases zero, including forget gates
initialization.seed_derivation: reset Python random, numpy PCG64 and torch manual_seed to cell seed before constructing fixed model module order; CUDA all devices same seed; dictionary has separate PCG64 seeded same value

pooling: arithmetic mean of valid node vectors after final GAT
